description: This file implements a command-line interface (CLI) for 1-Wire bus operations within the Zephyr RTOS, including commands for resetting the bus, reading/writing bits and bytes, configuring settings, and searching for devices.

methods.name: read_io_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for IO operations, specifically handling the '-r' reset option.

methods.name: cmd_w1_reset_bus
methods.description: Handles the 'reset' command to reset the 1-Wire bus for a specified device.

methods.name: cmd_w1_read_bit
methods.description: Handles the 'read_bit' command to read a bit from a 1-Wire device.

methods.name: cmd_w1_read_byte
methods.description: Handles the 'read_byte' command to read a byte from a 1-Wire device.

methods.name: cmd_w1_read_block
methods.description: Handles the 'read_block' command to read multiple bytes from a 1-Wire device.

methods.name: cmd_w1_write_bit
methods.description: Handles the 'write_bit' command to write a bit to a 1-Wire device.

methods.name: cmd_w1_write_byte
methods.description: Handles the 'write_byte' command to write a byte to a 1-Wire device, with optional bus reset.

methods.name: cmd_w1_write_block
methods.description: Handles the 'write_block' command to write multiple bytes to a 1-Wire device, with optional bus reset.

methods.name: cmd_w1_configure
methods.description: Handles the 'config' command to configure the 1-Wire host settings.

methods.name: search_callback
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a 1-Wire device is found during search.

methods.name: cmd_w1_search
methods.description: Handles the 'search' command to discover 1-Wire devices on the bus.
